theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_cfs_cyclic_weighted_infinitude
theorems.statement: ∀ (ι : Type) (m : ℕ) (ω : ℂ) (N : ι → ℕ) (g : ι → ZMod m) (D : Set ι), 0 < m → IsPrimitiveRoot ω m → (∀ i : ι, 2 ≤ N i) → (∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → Summable (fun i : ι => Real.rpow (N i : ℝ) (-s))) → (∀ k : Fin m, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → s < 1 + ε → ‖(∑' i : ι, ω ^ (k.val * (g i).val) * Complex.ofReal (Real.rpow (N i : ℝ) (-s))) - (if k.val = 0 then (Real.log (1 / (s - 1)) : ℂ) else 0)‖ ≤ C) → (∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 1 < s → s < 2 → (∑' i : {i : ι // i ∈ D}, Real.rpow (N i.1 : ℝ) (-s)) ≤ C) → ∀ a : ZMod m, Set.Infinite {i : ι | i ∉ D ∧ g i = a}
theorems.natural_summary: Combines accepted logarithmic fiber estimates with the accepted lemma that deleting a bounded-weight subset preserves infinitude.
